program:
app "My Plants" plant mint
table plant name text, days_gap num 1..60 = 3 unit "days"
table water plant ref plant
each plant sort name
  row card gap 1
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      "Water every" it.days_gap "days. Last:" since(it.water) "days ago" faint
    if(since(it.water) >= it.days_gap, "Water today", "OK") color if(since(it.water) >= it.days_gap, warn, good)
    button "Watered" tap add water plant = it
form plant, "Add plant"
describe:
My Plants, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- plant: name: text; days gap: number, 1 to 60, in days, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- water: plant: a plant. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each plant sorted by name:
  - text: its name.
  - text: "Water every", its days gap, "days. Last:", days since the last of its water entries, "days ago".
  - text: "Water today" when days since the last of its water entries is at least its days gap, otherwise "OK".
  - a button "Watered"; a tap adds a water with plant set to the plant.
- a form to add a plant.
hurried_style: terse like a search query, 2 to 6 words
fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Cards" cards slate
table point team pick Us|Them, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Us)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Them)
setting winat num = 100 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Us" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Us, pts = 1
  stack card grow align center
    "Them" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Them, pts = 1
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Us win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Them win!" head color good
describe:
Cards, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Us, Them; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 100.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Us.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Them.
Shows:
- text: "Us".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Us, pts set to 1.
- text: "Them".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Them, pts set to 1.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Us win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Them win!".
hurried_style: a short question, 4 to 10 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with the most unusual feature

program:
app "Journal Buddy" book plum
table entry mood num 1..5, note long
state d new entry
row gap 1
  each ["awful", "low", "okay", "good", "great"]
    button it fill if(d.mood = index + 1, accent, soft) tap set d.mood = index + 1
field d.note "What is on your mind?"
button "Save entry" tap save d
streak(entry) "day streak," count(entry last 7 days) "entries in 7 days" head
heat last 7 days, count(entry on it)
"Mood, last 30 days. Average" round(avg(entry.mood last 30 days)) faint
trend entry last 30 days sort at, it.mood
state q text = ""
field q "Search entries"
list entry where has(note, q) by day
describe:
Journal Buddy, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- entry: mood: number, 1 to 5; note: long text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: d, a new entry being filled in; q, starting at "".
Shows:
- for "awful", "low", "okay", "good", "great":
  - a button the value; a tap sets the mood of the d to its position plus 1.
- a box to fill in the note of the d, labelled "What is on your mind?".
- a button "Save entry"; a tap saves the new d.
- text: the current day streak of entry entries, "day streak,", how many entry entries in the last 7 days, "entries in 7 days".
- a heat map of how many entry entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- text: "Mood, last 30 days. Average", the average mood of entry in the last 30 days rounded.
- a line chart of its mood over entry in the last 30 days sorted by at.
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search entries".
- a list of entry where note contains q by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with who it is for

list trip by day
